title.en: An Act Declaring March Twenty-Two of Every Year as Malaybalay City Charter Day and a Special Working Holiday in the City of Malaybalay in Order to Commemorate the Anniversary of the Said City
title.orig: An Act Declaring March Twenty-Two of Every Year as Malaybalay City Charter Day and a Special Working Holiday in the City of Malaybalay in Order to Commemorate the Anniversary of the Said City

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8813_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In order to commemorate the charter anniversary of the City of Malaybalay, March twenty-two of every year is hereby declared as Malaybalay City Charter Day and a special working holiday in the said city.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
